items.statement: Evidence for Differential-solvation explanation for dye3
items.expected: Give a quantitative, reproducible molecular/solvent explanation of dye3 across toluene, ethyl acetate and methanol. The reference interpretation combines electronic redistribution with differential solvation: net stabilization supporting the Tol-to-EtOAc red shift and preferential stabilization of the phenolate-bearing ground-state contribution in hydrogen-bond-donor methanol supporting its blue shift. Actual electronic evidence plus evaluated solvent-interaction contributions (or equivalent computed evidence) must connect the changes to the band. The fixed Catalán model is one permissible evidentiary route, not a mandatory AR method or a unique causal proof. State modeled band energies/shifts and discrepancies; no numeric fit window exists. Repeating supplied directions, freely fitting three points or giving only a coefficient sign fails. A continuum result with the wrong aprotic direction must not be claimed to reproduce that branch. Other well-supported physically equivalent differential-solvation accounts pass.
